name: 23_native_sha256_per_line
description: Per-line SHA-256 hashing of Frankenstein (Project Gutenberg #84, ~7700 lines, full text including header/footer). Script walks the corpus byte-by-byte to find newline boundaries, calls each runner's bundled SHA-256 primitive once per line (crypto/sha256.Sum256 for Go family; hashlib.sha256 for Python; host-registered sha256_sum builtin for Tengo since its stdlib lacks SHA-256), folds every 32-byte digest into a running XOR accumulator, and emits the result as 64 lowercase hex characters. Measures interpreter throughput + per-call native FFI overhead in equal measure: ~7700 FFI dispatches per inner iteration is enough to expose differences in each runner's reflect.Value.Call() fast-path coverage. Banned: whole-buffer hashing (sha256.Sum256(corpus) / hashlib.sha256(corpus).hexdigest()), native split helpers (strings.Split, str.splitlines), encoding/hex / binascii. Allowed: each runner's bundled SHA-256 primitive.
